name: Weber bodykit + side skirts
blurb: Front lip, side skirts and rear valance.
body: Bolt-and-bond bodywork over the standard sills and bumpers. The manual clip pages are the useful part — knowing which fastener is a one-use clip saves rattles later.
watch: Skirts cover the jacking points. Mark where the pinch welds actually are before the first time you need to lift the car in a hurry.
A low front lip changes the approach angle. The manual lift and support points are still the only safe places to put a jack.
Trapped water behind a bonded skirt rots sills from the inside.
